name: Orimaki Suzu
source: Kisa's classmate, Suzu is a Jack that whose cheerful disposition draws attention from others. Suzu decided to enroll into Univers Theater School due to his admiration of the legendary Jack Ace, Tachibana Tsuki. The life of his class, he can strike up a conversation with anybody without fear or shyness. He does have a tactless side to him but he works arduously everyday to become a Jack Ace like Tachibana Tsuki.
